name: event
title: Event
description: An action that occurs at some location during some time.
notes: Derived from dwc Class event (http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/version/Event-2018-09-06). This class has been defined under the ltc namespace because it only has a subset of the properties of DwC:Event. All ltc:Event properties are borrowed from and reference the dwc namespace. Examples of an Event include: A specimen collection process. A camera trap image capture. A marine trawl.
rdfs:comment: An action that occurs at some location during some time.

fields.name: event_pk
fields.title: Event (Primary Key)
fields.description: A unique identifier for an ltc:Event.
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to guarantee uniqueness.
fields.rdfs:comment: A unique identifier for an ltc:Event.

fields.name: objectGroup_fk
fields.title: Object Group (Foreign Key)
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: This property refers to one or more related instances of the Event class.

fields.name: parentEvent_fk
fields.title: Event (Foreign Key)
fields.notes: The value in this field MAY be changed in aggregation to preserve the relationship to the (Primary Key).
fields.rdfs:comment: This property refers to one or more related parent instances of the Event class.

fields.name: eventName
fields.title: Event Name
fields.description: The name commonly used to identify or refer to the event.
fields.rdfs:comment: The name commonly used to identify or refer to the event.

fields.name: samplingProtocol
fields.title: Sampling Protocol
fields.description: The names of, references to, or descriptions of the methods or protocols used during an Event.
fields.notes: The primary use of this property is to describe the methods or protocols used to gather objects in the collection.
fields.examples: `UV light trap`, `mist net`, `bottom trawl`, `ad hoc observation`, `Penguins from space: faecal stains reveal the location of emperor penguin colonies, https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1466-8238.2009.00467.x`, `Takats et al. 2001. Guidelines for Nocturnal Owl Monitoring in North America. Beaverhill Bird Observatory and Bird Studies Canada, Edmonton, Alberta. 32 pp., http://www.bsc-eoc.org/download/Owl.pdf`
fields.rdfs:comment: The names of, references to, or descriptions of the methods or protocols used during a dwc:Event.

fields.name: verbatimEventDate
fields.title: Verbatim Event Date
fields.description: The verbatim original representation of the date and time information for an Event.
fields.rdfs:comment: The verbatim original representation of the date and time information for a dwc:Event.
